reasoning: On the season so far the Warriors are the stronger team; with home court the Warriors start about 8 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Warriors (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Warriors win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 199 and 248 total points.
